description: Land Acquisition - Walgammulla, Katuwana D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Village of Jaffna Town, Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While a government minister is named, the primary focus is on land matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
